High School Graduate General Studies upon hire or equivalent combination of education and experience required
One (1) year of experience in food service.

Sets and maintains par levels for all items required for Nutrition Services operations, adjusting as necessary based on census and usage. Reads recipes and orders correct quantities based on recipe needs. Under guidance from the Nutrition Services management team and in collaboration with nursing managers/directors, sets and maintains par levels for food and supplies in patient nourishment areas.

Creates and updates department order guide. Communicates with department vendors and members of the Nutrition Services staff and management team concerning items of need and any foreseen supply chain issues requiring substitutions. Collaborates with the Nutrition Services management team on adhering to department budgets.

Completes a thorough physical inventory of food, supplies, and cleaning chemicals prior to placing each order. Orders sufficient amounts of food, supplies, and cleaning chemicals in alignment with established par levels, avoiding overages and shortages, in compliance with all contracts, guidelines and requirements pertaining to purchasing. Chooses substitute food, supply, and cleaning chemical options in alignment with allergen and nutrient needs and in equivalence to original items.

Receives deliveries, checking accuracy, appropriate delivery temperatures and condition/damages. Takes appropriate action if there are discrepancies, missing item(s), or issues with product quality. Properly stores all products, following HACCP plan and maintaining regulatory compliance while utilizing the FIFO (first in, first out) method.

Maintains all storage areas (e.g. dry storage area, refrigerators, freezers, chemical room/closet, patient nourishment areas) in a clean and organized state, meeting regulatory requirements and ensuring proper rotation of items. Assists in the removal of food items in the event of a recall or other food safety concern. Reports any needed repairs, safety hazards, and/or equipment/storage needs to the Nutrition Services management team. Completes facility work orders, as needed.
